verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is API-first. The docs cover a Unified Payments API that manages the full payment lifecycle, including payment requests, refunds, payment links, transfers and an FX rates API. They also document OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and secret-key auth, idempotency keys on mutating endpoints, adaptive rate limits, webhooks manageable via API, a sandbox test account and an official Node.js SDK. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at standard paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
